posts.subject: Changelog - 29.12.2016 - MASSIVE KNIFE UPDATE
posts.bodyHtml:
[Bild]


--- Knife Server ---
Thanks to @WHAT for mentioning problems with the maps and suggesting some of the new ones.
In the last couple of days, I've been reworking all of the maps that @WHAT has mentioned by fixing bugs, changing the layout and changing the look of the maps.


Here is the complete changelog with all the changes done by me:


  • 35hp_3_2013 was going to be added but is now remade into 35hp_3_2013_dream

    • Here are some pictures of the before and after:

Before:
[Bild]


After:
[Bild]

I'm not that satisfied with the art direction myself, but it's much better than the old bland and dull version of this map.


  • 35hp_color was replaced with 35hp_colorful
  • 35hp_fepsi_v3 was added to the server
  • 35hp_forbiddenforest is being readded after being removed for being buggy and is now called 35hp_forbiddenforest_dream

    • All the bugs are now fixed (no more Kevlar at spawn, grenades are not reset after a new rounds, sometimes people spawned with a gun, etc.)
    • This map recieved an graphical overhaul because it looked bland as well

Here is a comparison picture (left: original ; right: reworked version)
[Bild]

  • 35hp_galaxy_v4 was remade into 35hp_galaxy_v5

    • a bug for Rubin Stamm players was fixed, meaning, they couldn't die after falling down the map, since they don't recieve any fall damage and therefore ended up stuck under the map
    • reworked lighting
    • people don't get to keep grenades after a round ends anymore
    • changed some of the textures
  • 35hp_lego_boxing_v2 was remade into 35hp_lego_boxing_v3

    • reworked lighting (prettier)
    • changed the boxing arena floor texture to feature more different lego textures and make the map look more interesting
    • replaced smoke-grenades with flashbangs since smokes always caused a delay in the boxing arena
  • 35hp_lego_warning_v2 was remade into 35hp_lego_dream

    • the entire map was made bigger again
    • people don't get to keep grenades after a round ends anymore
    • an extra bridge was added to both sides to make the middle bridges less crowded and to reduce the risk of 2vs1
    • the two middle bridges are now connected to allow for more fluid and controled gameplay


      Here is how the map looks right now:
      [Bild]


  • 35hp_minecraft_hell was remade into 35hp_minecraft_hell_v2

    • the spawn areas are bigger now, so there is now more room to fight, reducing the risk of 2vs1
    • people don't get to keep grenades after a round ends anymore
  • 35hp_notebook_ultimate was remade into 35hp_notebook_ultimate_v2

    • water looks actually pretty now
    • made the entire map bigger
    • tweaked the lighting
    • the ladder is now easier to climb
    • *** people now get a notification to stop ladder camping if they are standing too close to the ladder ***
  • 35hp_oasis was remade into 35hp_oasis_fix

    • people don't get to keep grenades after a round ends anymore
  • 35hp_ocean was remade into 35hp_ocean_v2

    • the middle area of the map was made bigger so it doesn't feel claustrophobic with all those players anymore
    • people don't get to keep grenades after a round ends anymore
    • water was made prettier
    • lighting was improved
  • 35hp_shipfight was remade into 35hp_shipfight_v2

    • people don't get to keep grenades after a round ends anymore
    • camping on the mast is now impossible since you now recieve a little bit of damage for being at the top area of the mast, so people have to come down eventually
  • 35hp_thenucleus was remade into 35hp_thenucleus_v2

    • people don't get to keep grenades after a round ends anymore
    • improved lighting
    • a bug for Rubin Stamm players was fixed, meaning, they couldn't die after falling down the map, since they don't recieve any fall damage and therefore ended up stuck under the map
  • 35hp_trampoline was removed from the server
  • 35hp_tropicana was remade into 35hp_tropicana_dream

    • rock and grass textures were changed to reflect make the map more tropic and therefore more appropriate for the name
    • improved lighting
    • people don't get to keep grenades after a round ends anymore
  • 35hp_$2000$_boxing was remade into 35hp_dream_boxing

    • complete rework of the map
    • changed the setting to a boxing match at night
    • the textures are now realistic and representitive of a box match
    • seats for the crowd were added
    • beams of the headlight are visible in the boxing ring
    • added atmospheric sound effects such as

      • as soon as a player enters the ring, a boxing bell sound is played
      • while a player is in the ring, he can hear the crowd cheering and being excited
    • other small details such as towels for the players and small splatters of blood
    • Here are some pictures of the before and after:

Before:

After:
[Bild]

  • MG | Last Light - V3 was added to the server (thanks @<<< !)
  • mg_kohztec_course was added to the server (thanks @<<< !)
